title: Technical Consulting Engineer - Web applications (Japanese Speaker)
locations: Kuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
teaser: Seeking a Technical Consulting Engineer to drive technology design, optimisation, and delivery for customer projects. Lead the development and deployment of web applications using Python and the MEAN stack, translating business requirements into scalable solutions. Ideal for experienced professionals with strong technical expertise and Japanese language proficiency.
description:
What You’ll Do

Drive technology design, optimisation, implementation and delivery for customer projects.

Develop and deploy software, automation and integration solutions using Python and the MEAN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, Angular and Node.js).

Translate customer business and technical requirements into scalable software and solution designs.

Develop RESTful APIs and web services using Python, Node.js, Express.js, JSON and XML.

Build web applications using Angular, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML and CSS.

Work with MongoDB and relational databases such as PostgreSQL/MySQL.

Assist customers with integration, implementation, troubleshooting and optimisation of Cisco technologies and software solutions.

Support presales activities, solution design, demonstrations and proof-of-concepts.

Build test environments to validate solutions and resolve complex technical issues.

Create technical documentation, customer collateral and knowledge-transfer materials.

Contribute to automation, reusable scripts, digital solutions and intellectual capital.

Work collaboratively with customers and cross-functional teams as an individual contributor.

Who You Are

Japanese Speaker - Proficiancy

BE/B.Tech/BSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT or equivalent, with 6+ years of relevant experience.

Strong experience in Python development, automation and scripting. Strong experience with the MEAN stack: MongoDB, Express.js, Angular and Node.js.

Experience developing full-stack web applications and RESTful APIs.

Good understanding of PostgreSQL/MySQL and NoSQL databases.

Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML and CSS.

Experience with Agile, DevOps and SDLC.

Strong software design, Object-Oriented Programming and problem-solving skills.

Experience with Git, Linux/Unix and unit testing.

Knowledge of algorithms, data structures, JSON/XML and REGEX.

Exposure to network automation, NETCONF, RESTCONF, YANG and networking concepts is desirable.

Experience working directly with customers and stakeholders.

Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills

Expertise

Python – Strong

MEAN Stack – Strong

MongoDB

Express.js

Angular

Node.js

RESTful APIs / Web Services

PostgreSQL / MySQL

JavaScript / TypeScript

Agile / DevOps / SDLC Git / Linux / Unit Testing

Network Automation / Cisco Technologies

Leadership / Autonomy

• Works independently with limited supervision on complex customer engagements.

• Provides technical guidance and mentoring to other engineers.

• Acts as a trusted technical advisor to customers and internal stakeholders.

• Shares knowledge, reusable solutions and lessons learned with the broader team.
